items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Charlie Haden. They were from there. So that was right from the start so that was kind of my expectation was people like that.

ctx.x: You’ve had some marvelous bass players on your recordings over the years.

Yeah. Well when I was in Los Angeles we played, I mean Scott LaFaro was one of the bass players that I played with. Charlie Haden. They were from there. So that was right from the start so that was kind of my expectation was people like that.
Is it possible to keep a band together these days?
